SELECT distinct ENUM_ID id ,ENUM_DSCR name FROM enumset.cm_guoku_enumeration WHERE STATE= 0
and ENUM_TYPE_ID = '${params.ENUM_TYPE_ID}'

SELECT c.`NAME`, d.ENUM_DSCR, CONCAT(e.ENUM_DSCR, "/", C.TITLE) AS DUTY FROM `inspection`.`inspection_group` a JOIN inspection.`inspection_group_user` b ON a.`INSPECTION_GROUP_ID` = b.`INSPECTION_GROUP_ID` JOIN inspection.`cm_guoku_talentpool` c ON b.`INSPECTION_GROUP_USER` = c.`UUID` JOIN (SELECT t.`ENUM_ID`, t.`ENUM_DSCR` FROM `enumset`.`cm_guoku_enumeration` t WHERE t.`ENUM_TYPE_ID` = '7') d ON b.`INSPECTION_GROUP_DUTIES` = d.ENUM_ID JOIN (SELECT t1.`ENUM_ID`, t1.`ENUM_DSCR` FROM `enumset`.`cm_guoku_enumeration` t1 WHERE t1.`ENUM_TYPE_ID` = '4') e ON c.`DUTIES` = e.ENUM_ID WHERE a.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} GROUP BY c.`UUID` ORDER BY CAST(d.ENUM_ID AS SIGNED), c.`UUID`
